about: Every setting in Olymparch, in one list. The Settings window draws its pages from it, olymparch-settings validates and applies from it, and tests/settings-coverage fails if anything configurable is missing. apply.via: shell = read live by the shell from settings.json; hypr = written to hypr.lua and applied with hyprctl eval; monitor = monitors.lua + hyprctl eval; idle = hypridle.conf + restart; audio = wpctl; cursor = hl.env + hyprctl setcursor; stored = kept in settings.json for the tool that uses it; action = runs a command; info = shown, not set. ready=false entries are shown as «coming».
